    Trade Routes¶

    Ge'or trades in spheres, not a web. Measured off the 597 AGD political map (scale bar 0–8000 km, 3.1 km/px): Ge'or spans ~49,000 km — a world 1.37× Earth. Bulk goods move under 2,000 km; heavy goods under 5,000 km seasonal; only luxuries survive multi-leg hauls past 8,000 km. Medieval hulls need a port every ~800 km. Most believe the world is flat — Lung and Sister receive no traders at all. The direct Merratodoni ↔ Demon Continent run is marked INFEASIBLE (measured, see § Measured Distances).

    Sphere & Power Home Feasible Route (with resupply) Key Outposts & Currency Why it works
    ERISDAR SPHERE — Anos Plutocracy South Erisdar Erisdar ↔ Luminous Ocean island chain → Dissenbarg ↔ Meble Lumina, Marti, Xeti, Kumir, Komme/Tatak (Dissenbarg), Meble Pearls trench — Anosi Mark Island chain (Luminous Sea Islands, Meble) gives resupply every ~600–1,200 km, measured 4,900 km total (33 days). Anos counts grain, not chokepoints
    ERISDAR SPHERE — Vennerian Trade Republic South Erisdar Erisdar → Vennerian Channel → Beast's Bay → Dissenbarg (via Luminous Ocean western edge) Mia, Goishi, Vennerian Channel, Kutten, New Venner, Johannstadt, Sua, Eribel — Vennerian Ducat / West Erisdarian Guilder Venner built the chokepoint. Shortest legal way east — everyone pays
    ERISDAR SPHERE — Sousu (Meble) Meble Meble ↔ Luminous Sea Islands ↔ Dissenbarg ↔ Xeti Kreb (Dissenbarg), Megrel (Xeti) — Meblean Pearl / Luminous Pearl Short hops only. Measured 2,200 km Erisdar↔Meble, ~5,000 km Meble↔Dissenbarg with chain. Meble file: "Remote from Erisdar and Merratodoni" — Sousu does not run Merratodoni; it feeds Dissenbarg/Xeti. 300m pearl divers can't provision a Greater Ocean crossing
    BEAST'S BAY SPHERE — Lumina / Marti / Xeti / Tuba Central Ge'or Lumina ↔ Marti (Aelefer Channel) ↔ Xeti (Vennerian Channel) ↔ Beast's Bay ↔ Tuba (Lesser Ocean, 2 seasonal legs via Goblin Island) Beast's Bay hub, Aelefer Channel (Lumina-Marti land bridge), Vennerian Channel (Marti-Xeti), Vennerian Pride (Tuba) — Luminal Tusk / Martian Drum / Xetian Coil / Tubian Feather The densest sphere. Lumina/Marti/Xeti ring Beast's Bay — bay-rim ports sit 200–1,500 km apart (bay circumference, not centroid). Marti-Xeti are land-connected via Vennerian Channel — wagons, not ships. This is where Lumina Spices and Marti Hides change hands 3 times before reaching Erisdar
    KUTTEN-DEMON-WEST ERISDAR CORRIDOR Kutten / Demon Continent / West Erisdar West Erisdar ↔ Demon's Horn (strait ~1,000 km) ↔ Demon Continent ↔ Demonic Sea (seasonal ~5,500 km) ↔ Kutten Love of Sea (Kutten), Yakut, Demon's Horn (free port), Augagarten — Kutten Fang / Demonic Ember Measured, not guessed: Demon's Horn↔West Erisdar is a strait (Asatru enclave sits on the West Erisdar coast per the map — the border is adjacent). Kutten is ~5,500 km across the Demonic Sea — a monsoon-season lane (Indian-Ocean-style: dhows ran 3,000–5,000 km seasonal legs). Kutten Furs/Salt cross it with the autumn wind, never all year. Only heavy/luxury goods pay for the passage
    KOBRE-TUBA SOUTHERN SPHERE Kobre / Tuba Kobre ↔ (two ~3,000 km legs via Goblin Island) ↔ Tuba ↔ Lesser Ocean → Lumina Coalsteel forges, Goblin Island (Tuba south), Mamanolo — Kobran Gear / Tubian Feather Measured: Kobre↔Tuba ≈ 6,500 km centroid, but Goblin Island splits the run into two ~3,000 km seasonal legs (file: "sailing west from Goblin Island lands on Kobre's southern coast"). Not 500 km — but doable twice a year, like the Indian Ocean dhow trade. Kobre Coal/Gear goes to Tuba, then Lumina, then Erisdar via Beast's Bay — never direct to Demon/Merratodoni
    GREATER OCEAN SPHERE — Merratodoni (expedition lane) Merratodoni (center, Greater Ocean) Merratodoni ↔ Tabontabar (~5,900 km) and ↔ West Dissenbarg (~5,900 km) — one convoy per season, ships that may not come back Human Republic, Purple Coast, Crab Union harbors, Luzia — Merratodoni Liberty Measured: Merratodoni's nearest land is Tabontabar at ~5,900 km. No near neighbor exists — the Liberty is printed to fund one brave convoy a season (Purple Dye is precious enough to justify it). Everything else is 10,000+ km NO-GO
    FAR EAST — Tabontabar / South Sun Empire East of Sun Archipelago Tabontabar ↔ Sun Archipelago ↔ South Sun Empire (internal sea, ~4,000 km chain) Northern Kingdom, Central Kingdom, Southern Kingdom — Tabontabar Triad / South Sun Aureus Internal archipelago trade. South Sun file: "west archipelago of Tabontabar" — adjacent, not distant. No regular route to Erisdar — measured 16,000+ km with no chain
    FREE PORTS — Neutral Exchange Free Isles At every hub, but ships come to them Karabar (golden forest), Zahor (south of Lung), United Kingdom of the Seamen (South Crab Archipelago), Demon's Horn — Freeport Doubloon Not a route — a service. Free ports honor all currencies (Freeport Concord). Every captain stops to exchange

    📏 Measured Distances (597 AGD map, scale bar 0–8000 km)¶

    Method: scale bar detected programmatically on the 16,000×8,000 map — one 1,000 km segment = 324 px → 3.086 km/px. Map width 49,376 km ≈ 90% of 1.37× Earth's circumference (54,900 km) — internally consistent. Landmass centroids from connected-component analysis; bay/strait pairs use rim distances. Equirectangular projection, ±15%.

    No-Go Routes — Why They Don't Exist (Realism)¶

    Claimed Route Distance & Hazard Verdict
    Merratodoni ↔ Demon Continent via Formingar Ocean Measured 22,000 km open Greater + Formingar, 148 days at speed, no resupply chain, The Groom vortex mid-route, 1.37× Earth means rougher seas. Medieval hull = no. You were right — not feasible NO-GO. Merratodoni's only lanes: Tabontabar (~5,900 km) and west Dissenbarg (~5,900 km), one convoy a season. Indirect chain Demon → Kutten → West Erisdar → Luminous Islands → Dissenbarg → Merratodoni is 5 legs, not 1
    Meble ↔ Merratodoni Meble file: "Remote from Erisdar and Merratodoni" + cold harsh, no organized contact. Measured 8,000+ km NO-GO. Sousu feeds Dissenbarg/Xeti, never Greater Ocean
    Sister / Lung → anywhere Measured Lung↔Zahor only 1,400 km — but lore: "Seas around Lung are violent and nearly impassable. Most of Ge'or believes the world is flat — Lung and Sister are unknown" + North glassed by Hybrians, Hive in center NO-GO. Distance is not the blocker — the sea is. Machine Liturgy has no coin for a reason — isolation by design. No trade, only legend
    Polar (Alborric) → anywhere "Separated from Marti by frozen ocean, reachable by walking south from Kramsadar through permafrost" NO-GO. No sail route — only foot over ice, seasonal. Angel Halo tithe, not trade
    Kutten → Merratodoni Kutten desert east of Demon, Merratodoni center Greater Ocean — measured 14,000+ km across a planet NO-GO. Kutten Salt/Furs go west to Demon/West Erisdar
    Erisdar → Moonfang Measured 15,800 km, Wolf Ocean beyond reason NO-GO. Moonfang barters in fangs and bones because nothing comes to it

    Key Waterways — Full¶

    Route Significance
    Beast's Bay SE Lumina / NE Marti / W Xeti hub. Busiest on Ge'or. Pidgin only. Bay-rim ports measured 200–1,500 km apart
    Vennerian Channel Xeti ↔ Marti — Marti-Xeti are land-connected via this cut. Venner tolls. Ducat only
    Aelefer Channel Lumina ↔ Marti land bridge — mentioned in Marti file. Wagon route, not sail
    Luminous Ocean Erisdar ↔ Dissenbarg. Island chain (Luminous Sea Islands + Meble) = resupply every 600–1,200 km. Measured 4,900 km total. Pearls guard the lanes
    Greater Ocean Dissenbarg west ↔ Merratodoni center. Measured ~5,900 km — the one expedition lane of the Liberty convoys. Everything else across it: NO-GO
    Lesser Ocean Tuba ↔ Lumina — measured 3,900 km with staging. Seasonal, less contested
    Formingar Ocean Hazard, not route. Contains The Groom vortex NW of Kobre. Avoided. Separates Kobre/Demon from Merratodoni but not crossed directly
    Demonic Sea Demon Continent ↔ Kutten — measured ~6,400 km, monsoon-season lane (cut winter ice claims). NOT 300 km. Kutten Salt/Furs cross with autumn wind
    Kutten Sea Lumina north ↔ Mia island — separates Lumina from Mia
    Xeti Sea South of Xeti, approach to Vennerian Channel
    Marti Sea South of Lumina, north of Marti — bay rim
    Wolf Ocean Tabontabar ↔ Sister/Lung — violent, Machine isolation
    Lung Ocean Kobre/Marti south — coal barges seasonal (before the seas closed)
    Silver Coast East Erisdar seaboard — Anos/Venner home waters

    Trade Rivalry — 4 Corners, not 1 race¶

    • Anos (counts) vs Venner (taxes) — core Erisdar ↔ Dissenbarg race (4,900 km island lane), as before.
    • Sousu (holds islands) — 3rd power with Pearls/Cowries/Jade, resupply chains on Luminous Ocean. Neutral, respected.
    • Merratodoni Liberty (prints) — underwrites the only Greater Ocean convoys (5,900 km to Tabontabar / west Dissenbarg). Ships may not come back — the coin prices that risk. Most distrusted by old empires.
    • Niche monopolies — Asatru Empire/Kutten/Kobre run the north-south industrial corridor via Demon's Horn (strait) + Demonic Sea (monsoon). Freeport Concord runs neutral exchange everywhere.

    Languages of trade: Venner Trade Pidgin on deck, Anosi Cant in counting houses, Erisian Common on ledgers, Trade Sign Cant in gale — 100 bloc tongues ashore.
